title: Debounce the search box
prompt:
The search box fires a request on every keystroke. Implement `debounce(fn, wait, timers)` in src/debounce.js: the
returned function delays calling `fn` until `wait` ms have passed without another call, then calls it once with the
latest arguments. It has `.cancel()` (drops a pending call) and `.flush()` (runs a pending call now). `timers` is
`{ setTimeout, clearTimeout }` (defaults to the globals) so tests can drive time.
